text:
maya: Heads up — after the kernel swap in eu-west last night we saw a 2.8x jump in p99 for short-chat workloads. Noticed a lot more cross-zone spillover into us-west during the 03:00–04:00 window. Logs + flamegraphs attached below. :frowning:
jun: Saw the alert. Is this only short-chat (<= 64 tokens) or long streams too?
maya: Mostly short-chat, 8–48 token requests. Long streams p50 unchanged. p99 for short-chat ~420ms -> ~1200ms at peak.
liam: Can you paste the kv-cache hit rate around the spike? My gut says kv warmup + kernel selection mismatch.
maya: kv cache hitrate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.61 for eu-west for those buckets. CPU usage on the serving hosts was fine, GPU SM util down slightly, but kernel fallback logs show a few model kernels recompiled to a different tiling path.
samira: If kernels fallback we can get larger per-token latency variability. Any evidence of batching heuristics changing (batch sizes or token budgets)?
maya: Yes — continuous-batcher stats show average batch size for that queue went up (5 -> 12), but token_budget_per_batch target stayed the same; queue depth increased due to regional spill steering sending requests to fallback nodes.
jun: That suggests queue policy is doing spillover when local capacity is full, but the receiving region isn't honoring strict affinity so it tries to batch aggressively and then kernel mismatch kills tail.
liam: Can you dump a sample of the queue policy config and the relevant metrics (batch_size_hist, kv_hit, kernel_id)?
maya: Paste of the short dump:
```
queue_policy: {
  region_affinity_weight: 0.65
  cross_zone_spill_threshold: 0.75
  token_budget_target: 512
  allow_rebatch_on_accept: true
}
```
batch histogram (short-chat): [1,1,3,6,20,45,30,12]
kv_hit_by_slot: [0.98,0.96,0.92,0.70,0.61]
kernel_ids_seen: [k_v1_opt, k_v1_fallback, k_v2_tiling]
```
jun: region_affinity_weight 0.65 is kinda low for eu-west busy windows — we're letting >30% go elsewhere. Also token_budget_target 512 for short chats is too large; causes larger batches with heterogeneous prefixes and colder KV cache.
samira: Proposed quick experiment:
- reduce token_budget_target -> 256 for short-chat queue
- bump region_affinity_weight -> 0.85 during peak hours
- set allow_rebatch_on_accept=false to avoid aggressive coalescing on accept
Target: bring p99 back under 600ms within 1 hour of rollout, watch kv_hit and cross-zone spill rate.
liam: Agree. Also add metric gate: if p50 jumps > 15% in recipient zones, rollback. And add kernel pin policy: prefer k_v1_opt for short-chat until kv_hit > 0.85.
maya: I'll craft a canary config and run a 15m canary in eu-west, then roll to fleet if stable. Canary name: "eu-shortchat-affinity-tune-213333".
ops-bot: Deploy request received for canary eu-shortchat-affinity-tune-213333. Starting canary with 5% traffic, 3 nodes, 900s observation.
jun: Also hook in kv cache profiler to the canary: sample prefixes and measure cold miss ratio per kernel. We want evidence kernel selection change caused miss amplification.
maya: Will do. I'll push the canary config in ~10m, will paste the manifest here. If anyone wants to pair up on quick metrics dashboard let me know. :eyes:
samira: I'll watch the dashboards and have the rollback playbook ready. Good call to pin kernels.
liam: Quick command to monitor canary stats locally:
```
curl -sS 'https://telemetry.internal/v1/query' -d 'q=avg_over_time(batch_size_hist{canary="eu-shortchat-affinity-tune-213333"}[5m])'
```
maya: Canary started. Initial 5m: p99=590ms, kv_hit=0.79, cross_zone_spill=0.12 (was 0.38). Good trend.
jun: Nice. Keep an eye on kernel_id churn.
maya: 20m in: p99=510ms, kv_hit=0.86, kernel churn down to baseline. Increasing canary to 25%.
liam: Okay to promote if p99 stays <600 and recipient region p50 stable. Also file a follow-up to add adaptive token_budget_target per request-length histogram.
maya: Will open an RFC after this to discuss adaptive budgets + per-region kernel pins. For now rolling to 100% with staged traffic. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Canary eu-shortchat-affinity-tune-213333 promoted to 100% at 2133334600.
samira: Monitoring — no regressions observed in recipient zones. Closing loop once RFC is up.
maya: Filing RFC PR: rfc/2026-03-18-adaptive-token-budgets.md — linking once done. :rocket:
